envelope.description: Scope concept.resolve to its area and return the anchor

body.title: Scope concept.resolve to its area and return the anchor
body.summary: Restrict concept.resolve candidates to the area (inAreaOf), add ConceptAnchor (path, kind, source, entityId and filePath for a symbol) to the output, convert a ranked entity hit to a symbol anchor, and return the named area as the anchor even when no hit exists; a repo or workspace scope returns hits[0] converted, or none.
acceptanceChecks: no hit outside the named area is returned and the anchor is the area with source named-scope even with no hit
a child that outranks the named module does not displace the anchor
a workspace or repo scope returns hits[0] as the anchor
a ranked entity hit becomes a symbol anchor

tests.name: concept-resolve-scope.test.ts: no candidate outside the area, anchor named-scope with an empty hit list, a child does not displace the anchor, symbol anchor identity, entity hit to symbol anchor, workspace and repo results equal today's
